LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 TENSE: FUTURE TIME USING WILL/SHALL

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: which feature will and shall. 1. Which words do we use to show future time?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences
2. use will and shall to express future time correctly

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 TENSE: FUTURE TIME USING WILL/SHALL
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall helps you succeed in ENGLISH LANGUAGE. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 TENSE: FUTURE TIME USING WILL/SHALL
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences

What this means
In this part you learn to identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Use will and shall to express future time correctly

What this means
In this part you learn to use will and shall to express future time correctly. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: use will and shall to express future time correctly.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can use will and shall to express future time correctly. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall to a partner. (skill: use will and shall to express future time correctly)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences.
3. Practise this skill: use will and shall to express future time correctly.
4. Make one local Kenya example of Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall from your county, market, farm, or school.
5. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. which feature will and shall. 1. Which words do we use to show future time?
2. How do you tell that something will happen in the future?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences.
5. Be able to: use will and shall to express future time correctly.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
